text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty page fired: eval-gate:prompt_quality_regression -> Severity: P2. Trigger: 'prompt_quality_score' dropped below threshold for model: gptx-3.8-quant (hosted). Auto-page enabled. Link: https://pd.redwood.example/INC-2026-045

pagerduty: Automatic escalation to ML Oncall (ben_ml_oncall) and SRE (eva_sre). PagerDuty incident: INC-2026-045.

ben_ml_oncall: acked. I'm on it. Quick TL;DR from the alert: eval gate tripped on production prompt set 'checkout-assistant-2026-03' — safety token rate up, toxic_class probability went from 0.2% -> 1.5% over last 10k responses.

alice_research: adding context: our nightly eval job showed a slow upward drift starting ~2026-03-12 22:00 UTC after the last prompt rollout. Might be prompt scheduling change + a minor model variant swap on canary.

carmen_se: Are any paying customers impacted? I saw a support ticket that mentions weird completions in EU region.

product_ops: Confirmed: two hosted customers (enterprise trial) reported hallucinated instructions in checkout flow; severity low functional but could be product blocking for a couple of sessions. No Dedicated VPC customers affected per first pass.

ben_ml_oncall: Steps I'm doing now:
- snapshot failing eval examples
- disable auto-rollout for 'prompt-policy-2026-03'
- roll back live prompt to policy 'prompt-policy-2026-02' for production traffic if that reduces regression
- throttle traffic to gptx-3.8-quant and route 20% to gptx-3.8-fp16 fallback variant

ben_ml_oncall: Running rollback command now:
```
redwoodctl rollout revert --policy prompt-policy-2026-03 --to prompt-policy-2026-02 --reason "eval-gate fail -> safety drift"
```

observability-bot: metric snapshot (most recent 10k responses):
```
metric/prompt_quality_score: baseline 98.7 -> current 96.2 (-2.5)
metric/toxic_prob_p95: baseline 0.21% -> current 1.45%
metric/avg_response_length: +12%
alerts/eval_gate_trips: 1 (triggered at 1802345500)
```

ben_ml_oncall: Rollback submitted. Waiting for rollout to finish (watching canary). Also disabling the automated prompt scheduler that pushed the change at 2026-03-12T21:58Z.

eva_sre: I've seen a small spike in GPU utilization on the quant nodes that coincides with the traffic spike, but nothing that suggests infra corruption. I'll keep an eye. If rollout rollback doesn't improve quality, we may need to scale down the quant variant and route more to fp16.

nick_infra: Adding: can we temporarily pin model to fp16 variant for affected routes? Command:
```
redwoodctl routing update --route /v1/generate --model gptx-3.8-fp16 --percent 80 --selector region=eu
```

ben_ml_oncall: Doing a safer step first: route 20% away from quant -> executing now.

ben_ml_oncall: Update: rollback completed, canary healthy. Quality metrics starting to trend back toward baseline (prompt_quality_score 97.8). Still monitoring.

product_ops: Thanks. Can we prep messaging for the two customers who reported issues? Draft: 
"We temporarily observed degraded completions for the checkout assistant due to a recent prompt policy change. We’ve reverted that change and are monitoring; please let us know if you see further issues."

carmen_se: I'll send that to the two customers and offer a short debrief tomorrow.

alice_research: I'll collect the failing eval examples and open a regression ticket with examples + diff vs baseline. Will attach to INC-2026-045.

ben_ml_oncall: Noting root-cause hypothesis: prompt-policy tweak + canary variant scheduled at similar time caused prompt-template expansion to surface edge tokens that trigger safety model. Need to add more targeted unit tests into eval gate and broaden prompt coverage.

observability-bot: auto-created issue: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2026-789 (Regression repro + augment eval set)

eva_sre: Handoff: I'm taking the rest of oncall for this incident. ben, leave any notes you want in the incident doc and I'll keep the bridge open.

ben_ml_oncall: Handoff ack. Notes added to incident doc and attached repro set. If quality drifts again, escalate to SecOps and product for customer notifications and legal review.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-045 status: Mitigated -> impact limited -> monitoring. PagerDuty: mark as acknowledged and on-call handoff complete. :white_check_mark:

product_ops: Follow-ups:
- Add failing examples to eval corpus, create new unit tests for prompt-policy changes.
- Disable auto-rollout for 24h after prompt-policy updates.
- Postmortem scheduled: 2026-03-15 16:00 UTC (owner: alice_research)

carmen_se: I'll track customer follow-up and share any replies.

ben_ml_oncall: Final note: If you see any repeated PagerDuty pages from eval gates for non-critical regressions, let's consider rate-limiting pager noise (mute non-prod and lower severity), but keep safety gates as pages. We should tune thresholds to avoid alert-fatigue.

observability-bot: closing note: eval pipeline has been paused for immediate dataset collection. Resume TBD after regression repro & test fixes.

pagerduty: INC-2026-045 -> Acknowledged by ben_ml_oncall; incident severity lowered to P3 for monitoring.

alice_research: I'll start a small A/B investigation to compare outputs between quant & fp16 variants over the next 12h and post results in this thread.

eva_sre: I'll own the postmortem runbook and link infra metrics. Leaving bridge open for 2h for monitoring.

ben_ml_oncall: thanks all. Closing my active tasks, handing off to eva and alice. :eyes:
